info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Salesforce Analytics REST API
info.description:
Access Salesforce reports, dashboards, and analytics data programmatically. Enables embedding analytics into custom applications, automating report generation, running reports synchronously or asynchronously, and managing dashboard components and filters.

Contact Support:
 Name: Salesforce Developer Support

item.name: reports
{reportId}
describe
Salesforce Sales Cloud Describe a report

variable.description: (Required) The 15 or 18 character Salesforce report ID

request.description: Retrieves detailed metadata about a report including the report type metadata, grouping column information, summary field information, and extended metadata. This information can be used to build dynamic report filter UIs.

{instanceId}
Salesforce Sales Cloud Get report instance results

variable.description: (Required) The 15 or 18 character Salesforce report ID
(Required) The ID of the report instance

request.description: Retrieves the results of an asynchronous report run using the instance ID. If the report is still running, the status is returned instead of results.
